source_scope: POROTHERM/Wienerberger low-rise technical album, 105 physical pages; source rules pages 5-19; 73 physical technical sheets in sections 1-12
critical_findings: Legacy POROTHERM extraction missed 11 real technical sheets: physical pages 71-73, 75-79, 81, 101-102. v2.6 adds them as source-supported machine records.
Seven legacy records are red section-divider pages, not constructible details. They remain only as reference_section_header records for compatibility and cannot compile geometry.
The source TOC says section 1 is sheets 1.1-1.4, but the physical album contains sheet 1.5 on page 25. Physical sheet footer wins; the inconsistency is preserved.
Product envelope dimensions for 12 POROTHERM block variants and 3 TERCA brick variants are captured from source tables; internal ceramic void geometry is not invented.

Masonry rules such as 125 mm planning module, 87 mm minimum bond for h=219 mm, slab bearing >=120 mm, parapet/plinth protection and sheet 12.1 mesh/anchors are source-bound but manufacturer/code claims are not treated as current verified norms.
